transports.note: updated_metadata polls and live_chat long-polls. Both are ordinary POSTs, so a table with no long-poll row records them as plain endpoints and reports the site as having no realtime transport.
Byte-identical to the /player payload, so the page alone answers what an API call would.
Gated on a visitorData minted by a browser that navigated the specific watch page; a bare POST's token returns UNPLAYABLE.
Caption tracks behind a signed URL sourced from /player.

axes.note: The same endpoint returns different data for different context.client values. Varying the client is a discovery dimension distinct from varying the URL, and no amount of endpoint enumeration finds it.
